advertised_yield_range: Normal public surface up to 12% APY; temporary 2026 campaigns advertised 33%, 100%, 500%, 1000% APR-equivalent rewards, and an August transfer-linked campaign described as effectively 150% annualized, subject to term, eligibility, and reward-cap conditions.
lockup_or_withdrawal_terms: Public lending flows allow selection of lending amount and period and state that principal plus interest return to the IZAKA-YA wallet after the lock period. Campaign-specific conditions may require completing a term or additional eligibility steps to receive promotional rewards.
custody_or_counterparty_model: Account-based IZAKA-YA wallet using provider-operated service infrastructure; reviewed public sources do not fully resolve the exact lending counterparty, legal ownership transfer, service-independent recovery path, asset deployment, or rehypothecation mechanics.
notes: Headline promotional annualized rates are issuer-advertised campaign formulas and are not treated as verified realized customer returns. A current first-party lending article explicitly warns that crypto-lending principal is not guaranteed.
